description: #2408: dated per-file excuses for the three doc gates (check-doc-links, check-doc-style, check-phantom-command-scan). An entry is only legitimate when the real fix is a prose or product decision owned by another issue — a path/link/frontmatter one-liner gets fixed, never listed. Every entry expires; the gate goes RED the day after, so the debt cannot rot silently. Rules: doc-links | doc-style | phantom-command.

entries.reason: Open decision (#2917): ship the `arbiter audit run` subcommand, or drop it from the emitted governance playbook. Until then the playbook documents it as "planned, not yet shipped", and excusing the file keeps `audit` out of the emitted-surface ledger, which would otherwise demand a row for a command that does not exist.

Open decision (#2917): make the scanner resolve emitted-doc citations against the emitted tree, or stop citing the path literally in this doc. It cites `node scripts/check-gdpr-controls.mjs`, an overlay-conditional gate emitted into the CONSUMER tree only and correctly absent from arbiter scripts/. Do not create the file.
